title: Triage + Growth 1:1 prep — Priya Sen
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Priya Sen (senior SWE) — 30 minutes
Date: 2026-10-13 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent)
Location: video / huddle room B if in-office

Objective: mix of short-term triage (latency regression + canary) and medium-term career conversation (IC3->IC4 readiness). Leave with 2-3 concrete actions and a clear unblock plan for the canary.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m quick personal check-in (energy, time off, context)
- 5-12m triage status: KV cache A/B experiment + p95 regression on prod-canary
- 12-20m rollout decision & operational plan (fallback policy, trunk PRs, manual mitigations)
- 20-28m career calibration: strengths, visible impact, promotion readiness checklist
- 28-30m wrap & set actions / follow-ups

Notes to self (manager prep)
- Priya has been heads-down on the KV caching heuristics A/B test (INF-2345). Last update in Slack thread #kv-cache said A variant reduced token cost by ~8% but increased p95 for template-heavy prompts. Need specifics: which models, sequence length distribution.
- Check PR #482 for the canary rollout gating logic — there was a revert flag added by ops yesterday. Ask if she expects the revert to fix p95 or if it's a masking workaround.
- She's been asking for more ownership (runbook lead, oncall rotation swap). Good time to offer incremental leadership (lead the next incident postmortem + present to infra rota).
- Watch tone: when stressed she defaults to technical detail; for career convo, surface higher-level impact and stakeholder work (console dashboards, cross-team syncs).

Triage items / talking points
- Current symptom: prod-canary p95 latency +14% last 36 hours after KV heuristics rollout. Incidence only on template-heavy prompt traffic; no increase in p99.
- Hypotheses: (a) heuristic mis-prunes beneficial cache entries for templates, (b) batching interactions with cache eviction timing, (c) kernel scheduling change in last runtime patch.
- Ask: which telemetry dashboards did you check? (tokenization distribution, sequence length histograms, hot-key skew, GPU utilization).
- Safety: ensure rollback plan is tested. Is the canary configured to auto-fallback to previous model variant? If not, can we stage that in the next hour?
- Ask for concrete next steps: run targeted replay for template-heavy traffic (playback job id?), add a short-term cache-threshold override, and schedule a follow-up incident sweep.

Operational checklist (to confirm in meeting)
- Is there a dedicated replay job: replay-job-2026-10-12-19 (confirm status)?
- Who owns the canary policy: ops vs runtime team? (note: last commit shows Priya as PR author but ops added gating flag)
- Confirm feature flag name: runtime.kvcache.heuristics (used in PR)
- If rollback: test on dedicated staging cluster first, then prod-canary, then full rollout.

Career / calibration (IC3 -> IC4 readiness)
- Evidence to surface: led the KV caching project, measurable token cost improvement in A variant (~8%), authored runbook draft, cross-team demo with Platform last month.
- Gaps: broader stakeholder visibility (Console dashboards visibility), mentoring others (pairing, code reviews frequency), owning a postmortem end-to-end including customer comms.
- Suggested next steps for Priya this quarter:
  1) Own the next incident postmortem write-up and publish to Confluence (I will sponsor and review).
  2) Lead a 30-min cross-team sync (runtime + ops + console) to align on rollout policies — date target: by Oct 27.
  3) Formalize 2 mentorships: pair with one junior engineer on perf investigations, set weekly 45min slot.
- Ask: does Priya want me to open a promotion calibration packet? If yes, we should gather 3 artifacts: one technical design + impact metric, one cross-functional project summary, and peer feedback. Offer to draft the first two bullets.

Coaching prompts (useful phrasing in convo)
- "Walk me through the causal chain — from heuristic decision to observed p95 spike — what telemetry convinced you it was candidate X?"
- "If you owned the rollout policy, what would the ideal canary look like for this feature?"
- "What part of this work do you want on your CV / promotion packet? I'll help make it visible."

Action items (assigned & due)
- Priya: run targeted playback for template-heavy traces (replay-job id or link) and report back with histogram overlays + hypothesis validation — due: 2026-10-13 EOD.
- Evan (me): prepare brief ops fallback checklist and coordinate with SRE to enable auto-fallback on prod-canary if tests fail — due: 2026-10-13 noon.
- Priya: draft incident postmortem skeleton and share for review — due: 2026-10-20.
- Evan+Priya: schedule cross-team sync invite (runtime, ops, console) and draft agenda — due: 2026-10-18.

Follow-ups to add to calendar / trackers
- Add checklist items to INF-2345 and link the replay results.
- Create a short Slack broadcast (ops channel) after we decide rollback; keep messaging crisp: cause, mitigation, ETA.

Unresolved questions to surface in meeting
- Does the p95 increase correlate with specific instance types (A100 vs H100) or firmware/kernel versions?
- Is there any correlation with quantization changes pushed last week?
- Are there customer-facing errors or SLA hits yet? (if yes, escalate comms)

Notes to file after meeting (post-meeting, copy this into doc)
- Decision: if playback reproduces p95 spike -> enable runtime.kvcache.heuristics=false on prod-canary, escalate to full rollback if auto-fallback not triggered.
- Career: Priya wants me to draft promotion artifacts and run a mock 5-minute leadership pitch.

Quick templates (copyable during meeting)
- Slack rollback message: "Ops/Runtime: rolling back runtime.kvcache.heuristics on prod-canary due to p95 regression observed in template-heavy traces. Playback test in progress. ETA 30–60m. Will post update."
- Postmortem skeleton headings: Summary, Timeline, Root cause, Contributing factors, Mitigations, Action items, Owner(s).

Closing checklist before meeting end
- Confirm Priya has time-block for replay job (30–60m) and no conflicting oncall duties.
- Confirm I will own gating conversation with SRE during the next 2 hours if we need rollback.

Quick personal note (to self): be explicit about what success looks like for Priya (impact metrics + visibility) — promotion conversations without clear artifacts are weak.

---
Versioning / audit: paste any relevant commit ids into INF ticket and the PR before we close this item.
plain_text_preview: 1:1 prep: triage + growth — Priya Sen. Objective: triage KV cache p95 regression and plan promotion artifacts. Actions: Priya run replay by EOD, Evan prep rollback checklist by noon, schedule cross-team sync.
